title: Perfect internal Hom quasi-coherence
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and K,L objects of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume L has quasi-coherent cohomology. If K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then RSheafHom(K,L) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] has quasi-coherent cohomology, with no boundedness assumption on L.

proof.text: A perfect source has quasi-coherent cohomology, so regard K as an object of the quasi-coherent derived category.
Apply the derived internal-Hom tensor adjunction and the perfect RHom tensor comparison to obtain a quasi-coherent perfect dual D and an isomorphism c : L tensor^L D ≅ RHom(K,L).
Canonical derived tensor preserves quasi-coherence, so L tensor^L D has quasi-coherent cohomology; transport this property across c. No boundedness condition on L is used.
